audit_summary.position_specific_traits: Tiebreaks prefer positional criteria (QB: EPA/CPOE/pressure; RB: EPA/RYOE/receiving; WR: YPRR/EPA/separation; OL: PFF+ESPN win rates/penalties; EDGE: PRWR/pressures/sacks; LB: coverage+run; DB: coverage grade/INT/PD; K/P: FG/punt EPA/net). audit_summary.sample_availability_handling: CRITICAL CORRECTION vs prior draft: ratings = real ability/characteristics/style, not healthy-availability ranks. Limited/zero 2026 snaps → AVAILABILITY_FLAG + retain sustained elite evidence (Garrett, Parsons, Achane, Burns, and similarly Derwin James/Branch). Adequate 2026 sample of decline → current form can move a player down while keeping them ranked (Campbell, Witherspoon, Q.Williams, Bush, Aubrey/Boswell). Distinguish fields: current_form vs ability_evidence vs availability.
audit_summary.style_differences: Unique playing-style rule retained narratively; H2Hs note style when metrics split (e.g. Washington blocker vs Kelce router; Gibbs receiving vs Cook rushing).
audit_summary.pff_use: PFF overall is an input facet, never the rank by itself. ESPN win rates, nflverse/PBP/NGS, PFR pressures used alongside. Invented PFF facets forbidden; paywalled facets not inferred.
audit_summary.scarcity: No new scarcity pass in this deliverable; locked scarcity notes (e.g. Garrett FMV 96) retained as context. No new 95+ claims invented.
audit_summary.tie_handling: Exact orders published. Former LOW adjacent links resolved with sourced positional tiebreaks where justifiable; uncertainty remains labeled LOW (never silently relabeled MEDIUM). Near-ties explicitly caveated.
audit_summary.no_ea_as_ours: EA/Madden reference only; Page MADDEN variable contains existing Gridiron Standard full-card judgments, not EA values. Ours = Gridiron Standard judgments. No EA values adopted as ours.
audit_summary.engine_vs_analyst: Engine publication rule can remain strict (reject LOW edges → board unpublished). This file is the separate human-readable analyst proposal with full order + uncertainty. Not a baseline lock, not a Page update.
